project_name: Adwa Lens — AI-Powered WebAR Museum Companion

/api/health endpoint returns status ok

features.name: Landing Screen & Onboarding Permission Priming Modal

Switching language alters UI text and Voice AI system prompt/TTS language parameters cleanly without runtime audio stream errors
Permission priming modal triggers before browser media permission dialogs

Llama RAG generates persona-conditioned answer streaming to TTS
Browser speechSynthesis fires if ElevenLabs fails

features.name: Negarit Drum Direct Mesh Tap, Strike Button & Haptics

Hit triggers navigator.vibrate pulse and visual audio-wave canvas animation

Share / export button triggers card preview

verification_criteria: SVG map renders user location dot and route path
Tapping 'I am here' updates current stop index in session store

features.stream: Stream B — Vision AI & Voice RAG
features.name: Offline Service Worker & Top-20 Exhibit Pre-Cache
features.description: Build Service Worker caching top 20 exhibit JSON files, static persona scripts, and browser speechSynthesis offline fallback.
verification_criteria: Disconnecting network serves pre-cached exhibit JSON and static persona scripts

features.stream: Stream B — Vision AI & Voice RAG
features.name: AI Prompt Safety Guardrails & Off-Topic Redirection
features.description: Implement prompt guardrails in backend/lib/personas.js politely redirecting off-topic or inappropriate user questions back to exhibit context.
verification_criteria: Off-topic question triggers polite in-character persona redirection to museum topics

features.name: Accessibility & Ergonomics Pass
features.description: Perform WCAG contrast check, thumb-reachable CTA layout optimization, and sticky voice avatar captions overlay.
features.spec_reference: docs/adwa_lens_architecture.md Section 2 Screen 7 & docs/PHASES_AND_ROLES.md Stream C Phase 3
verification_criteria: Text passes contrast ratio checks and voice captions remain visible in sound-off mode

features.name: End-to-End Demo Path Validation & Rehearsal Pipeline
features.description: Validate unbroken execution of the complete 8-screen hero demo path per hackathon judging narrative arc.
verification_criteria: Full demo flow runs smoothly: Landing -> Planner -> LiveNav -> CameraScan -> InspectionHub -> VoiceGuide -> SensoryHub -> MemoryDeck

features.name: Offline-First Core Tour Experience
features.description: Provide a complete degraded-network tour using IndexedDB-cached exhibit content, curated local guide answers, queued session events, and browser speech synthesis so core exhibit discovery and personalized storytelling remain usable without the RAG service.
features.spec_reference: Critical product requirement — offline-first core experience
verification_criteria: A previously visited exhibit opens with its metadata, narrative, and persona-appropriate fallback answers while offline
Guide requests fall back to local curated content and browser speech synthesis without an error screen
Tour progress and analytics events queue locally and synchronize after connectivity returns

features.name: Provider Failure Handling & Graceful Degradation UX
features.description: Define normalized provider-failure states and user-facing recovery paths for Gemini Vision, Groq RAG, ElevenLabs, microphone/camera permissions, timeouts, and mid-conversation network loss.
features.spec_reference: Critical product requirement — robust error handling and graceful degradation
verification_criteria: Gemini Vision failure offers manual exhibit selection and retry without losing the tour state
ElevenLabs quota or stream failure switches to captions and browser speech synthesis
Network loss during a guide response preserves the transcript and presents a clear retry/offline option

features.name: Persistent Cross-Device Visitor Sessions
features.description: Allow visitors to save and resume a tour across devices using a privacy-preserving accountless recovery link or optional sign-in, with synchronized itinerary, persona, visited exhibits, badges, and preferences.
features.spec_reference: High-priority product requirement — user session persistence across devices
verification_criteria: Visitor can create a recovery link or sign in and resume an interrupted tour on a second device
Itinerary, persona, visited exhibits, badges, and accessibility preferences restore correctly
Expired or invalid recovery links show a safe, actionable recovery state

features.name: Museum Content Management System
features.description: Provide authenticated museum-staff workflows to create, review, publish, version, and roll back exhibit metadata, stories, translations, media, hotspot content, and 3D-model references without developer intervention.
features.spec_reference: High-priority product requirement — admin and content management
verification_criteria: Authorized staff can edit and publish exhibit copy and persona stories from an admin interface
Content changes are validated, versioned, and reversible
Published content is served to the visitor experience without a frontend deployment

features.name: Privacy-Safe Visitor Analytics & Insights Dashboard
features.description: Instrument privacy-safe visitor events and provide museum staff a dashboard for exhibit popularity, route drop-off, persona selection, feature use, session duration, and service-failure trends.
features.spec_reference: High-priority product requirement — analytics and insights dashboard
verification_criteria: Dashboard reports popular exhibits, drop-off points, persona usage, and time spent for a selectable date range
Analytics exclude raw audio, camera frames, and unnecessary personal data
Offline events are queued and deduplicated when sent after reconnection

phase_feature_locks._comment: Feature claiming system. Before building any feature, an agent or developer MUST claim it here via a PR that updates this file. Prevents two agents building the same thing. Claimed features show agent_id and branch. Released = merged to develop.
phase_feature_locks._instructions: To claim: set status='claimed', add your agent_id, branch, and claimed_at. To release: set status='released', add released_at after your PR merges. Allowed status values are only unclaimed, claimed, or released.
